sloka: न हि पश्यामि तत् सौम्य पृथिव्यामपि वानर ।सदृशं मत्प्रियाख्याने तव दातुं भवेत् समम् ।। ६.११६.२० ।।
transliteration: na hi paśyāmi tat saumya pṛthivyāmapi vānara ।sadṛśaṁ matpriyākhyāne tava dātuṁ bhavet samam ।। 6.116.20 ।।

translations.english: "Neither gold or silver or gems, not even kingdom or the three worlds are equal to what you have spoken now."
